title: Two camels
body: A class compares two camels. Camel X lives where sand covers the ground, days are very hot and nights are cold. It has long legs with wide hooves and one hump on its back. Camel Y lives in a high, mountainous region where winters are very cold. Its height and legs are shorter than those of Camel X, and it has two humps on its back. In late winter, when there is not much food around, the two humps of Camel Y shrink. Camel Y also grows long hair from its head to its neck. Both camels pass small amounts of urine, have dry dung and do not sweat, so they can go for many days without drinking water.
